cand.title: ZoomInfo President’s Club 2027
cand.excerpt: All-inclusive destination fit; adjacent/overflow and future capture only.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Prioritize Hannah Beardsley, ZoomInfo Executive Business Partner / Manager, Executive Assistance and senior assistant to the CRO: she personally described planning the 2026 President’s Club and was thanked on its committee. Prioritize Marci McCormack, EGT founder: EGT is the 2027 published operations contact, and Marci was individually thanked on the 2026 committee. Brendan Burke, EGT Senior Director of Global Travel Operations, is an additional agency routing candidate, not a verified 2027 account lead. Katie McDonald is historically relevant but her profile records leaving ZoomInfo in July 2026; do not present her as the current ZoomInfo buyer. No individual's 2027 hotel-signature authority is established.
findings.futureEdition: Verified activity dates are April 2–5, 2027, within the requested horizon. The organizer-operated event website repeats these dates beside W Punta Cana and supplies the actual trip agenda. April 1 is an authorized early-arrival date for West Coast/international travelers, not the main event start. No 2028 edition, destination or sourcing window was verified; do not extrapolate April 2028 dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana is a plausible future resort-incentive contender, not a city-conference pitch. Its published 620 rooms, all-inclusive catering, beach/courtyard/garden venues and three meeting rooms totaling 380 m² fit a guestroom-led reward trip with a short business meeting and celebratory functions. Published limits are 300 conference guests and 200 banquet guests; full-program fit cannot be established without the employee plenary count, total guests and awards-dinner layout. The 2027 program allows one adult guest per qualifier, requires guests to be over 21 and uses a luxury adults-only host. Alltra would need to demonstrate an acceptable adult incentive experience and service standard; equivalent positioning is not established.
findings.venueCommitments: W Punta Cana, Adult All-Inclusive is the announced host, not merely a preferred hotel: the agenda specifies check-in there, a business meeting in Great Ballroom B, pool gathering and beach awards dinner. The FAQ describes a discounted room block, hotel confirmations through Executive Group Travel (EGT), and ZoomInfo-funded accommodation. This establishes an operational host/lodging commitment, not access to the executed legal contract or proof of exclusivity. Marriott places the property on Carretera Uvero Alto, La Altagracia; this is a competing Uvero Alto resort, not Cap Cana demand.
findings.historicalRotation: Public evidence identifies Las Vegas in 2022; Grand Velas Los Cabos in a 2024 retrospective explicitly celebrating the 2023 achievement cohort; Grand Hyatt Baha Mar, Nassau, for the April 2025 trip; Andaz Maui for the April 2026 trip; and W Punta Cana for April 2027. Edition labels can refer to the earning year rather than travel year. The /2025/destination page still has a 2024 title, but its passport instructions reference departure on April 6, 2025 and a contemporaneous attendee confirms the Bahamas trip. Exact historical activity ranges remain unverified. Multiple editions establish recurrence and destination changes, not a contractual annual schedule or fixed rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The 2027 main hotel is already selected. EGT is the published lodging operations route: it issues confirmations through Trip Plans, quotes and confirms additional nights, and manages extensions at the existing discounted room-block rate, subject to availability. ZoomInfo covers three hotel nights, or four for West Coast/outside-US travelers, including room taxes and resort fees. Flights are through Navan; AMSTAR is named as the airport transportation partner, not proven to be the hotel buyer. No public RFP, replacement-hotel search or overflow allocation was verified. Residual lodging sourcing is unknown, not open by default.
findings.organizationStructure: ZoomInfo is the corporate incentive owner/sponsor, not an association. EGT is the external incentive travel planning/operations agency and is owned by BRBS EGT, LLC. W Punta Cana is the incumbent host hotel. AMSTAR is the named transportation partner. Navan is the flight-booking channel. These roles do not establish who signs the accommodation contract or controls future venue selection.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The incumbent is an integrated luxury adults-only all-inclusive, with accommodation and major functions planned on site. Inference: splitting attendees across resorts could weaken convenience and the reward experience. No sold-out host, displaced delegates, capacity shortfall, open overflow block or request for another hotel was found. Do not translate Alltra's 620 rooms into event demand or claim adjacent/overflow business solely because both resorts are in Uvero Alto. Alltra's 200-person published banquet capacity may constrain a larger combined qualifier-and-guest awards dinner; attendance is unpublished.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach EGT through its published info@executivegrouptravel.com contact, requesting routing to Marci McCormack or the ZoomInfo account lead; separately seek an introduction to Hannah Beardsley. Acknowledge W Punta Cana as the April 2–5, 2027 incumbent. Ask once whether a documented contingency hotel need exists; otherwise focus on the next uncontracted cycle. Request the sourcing timetable, destination shortlist, room pickup/peak rooms, total guests versus employee plenary attendance, banquet format, adult-only expectations, budget and contracting decision process. Offer a concise Alltra incentive brief and site inspection subject to fit, not a speculative 2027 block proposal. Keep ORS as final qualification/publication authority.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low accessibility for primary 2027 accommodation: the host hotel and lodging process are already announced elsewhere. Event registration and first-come extension nights at W Punta Cana are attendee services, not evidence of an open hotel procurement competition. Current-edition access is limited to an explicitly confirmed contingency/overflow requirement if EGT identifies one; none is presently evidenced.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the demonstrated multi-destination series supports a relationship-development approach for an unannounced later edition, including a possible 2028 cycle, but does not prove a 2028 event or a return to Punta Cana. Ask whether Dominican Republic resorts will be considered again and when hotel briefs are issued. Present Alltra only if destination, adult incentive positioning, budget and meeting/banquet requirements align. Do not displace the confirmed 2027 edition with an invented future opportunity.
